releases.name: v0.2.0 — First release: bilingual CLI, English-first docs
releases.notes:
**pixellogo 0.2.0** is the first tagged release: a command line tool that turns a title, a few subtitle lines and a footnote into real 8-bit / retro-terminal pixel art — PNG and SVG from the same geometry, five canvases, ten palettes, and mixed Latin / Chinese / Japanese / Korean text without missing glyphs.

## Highlights

- **Real pixels, not a filter.** Text is rasterized into a binary mask and merged per row into integer-coordinate rectangles. Every edge stays a whole block at any zoom: no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no feathering.
- **One geometry, two formats.** PNG and SVG are produced from the same `Scene`, so they match pixel for pixel. The SVG is self-contained and needs no font files.
- **Five canvases.** `poster` 1080×1440, `card` 1440×1080, `banner` 1280×640, `slide` 1920×1080, `square` 1080×1080, each with its own layout strategy.
- **Ten palettes.** From retro terminal to paper journal; every preset passes a WCAG contrast check (`--list presets` prints the ratio).
- **CJK-ready.** A Chinese pixel font ships in the box, so mixed Latin/Chinese lines keep one stroke weight; Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean download on demand.
- **Bilingual CLI.** Help page, option tables, font status, warnings and errors in English or Simplified Chinese — automatic from the terminal locale, or forced with `--ui-lang`.
- **No browser dependency.** Pure Python and Pillow ras…

releases.name: 3.0.1 — enforced candidate menu, per-source chains, comparing gate
releases.notes:
## What changed

3.0.1 closes the gap between what the README promised and what the code enforced. The short version: a Go model id can no longer be invented, chain length follows the source, Markdown agents can actually be written, the mode question is asked once, and `check` re-derives the numbers instead of trusting the file.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#301---2026-11-03) for the full list. The Chinese changelog is at [zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md).

## Install this release

Download **`opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip`** below. It is the minimal package, not the GitHub "source code" archive:

- top-level directory is `opencode-go-model-picker/`
- it contains only `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/` and `LICENSE` — no tests, no docs site, no `assets/`, no `.git`, no `node_modules`
- 18 files

Extract it into your OpenCode skills directory so the folder name matches the skill name:

```bash
unzip opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -d ~/.config/opencode/skills/
```

```powershell
Expand-Archive opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -DestinationPath "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\skills"
```

Then ask OpenCode to check your agent models. The skill is read-only until you confirm a diff.

en.headline: 73 own commits plus 22 automated commits across five repositories
en.summary: **73 own commits** landed across five repositories, plus 22 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 26 commits added a bilingual CLI, on-demand multilingual glyph variants, a Korean Galmuri font fix, layout adjustments, and expanded documentation with a 40-image example gallery. The `v0.2.0` release published the first tagged version, generating matching PNG and SVG pixel art from one geometry with five canvases, ten palettes, and Latin, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 17 commits tightened the `plain-language` skill to 46 lines and six red lines, documented the branch-and-chapter workflow in `AGENTS.md`, and updated the role roster and routing rules. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 16 commits added the `starlight-docs` skill scaffold with detect, scaffold, check, audit, and emit-check scripts, restored mobile theme and language controls, and refined external-link failure classification. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 8 commits reworked daily and summary wording to count issue and PR actions, rejected bare issue counts, and documented branch-based development requirements. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, 6 commits enforced the candidate menu, per-source chains, and a fail-closed comparing gate, and the `v3.0.1` release aligned the README with those checks.

releaseNotes.summary: The first tagged release introduced a bilingual CLI that renders titles, subtitles, and footnotes as 8-bit pixel art. PNG and SVG share one geometry, with five canvases, ten palettes, and mixed Latin, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text.

This release enforced the candidate menu, per-source chains, and a comparing check gate so model IDs cannot be invented and `check` re-derives values instead of trusting the file. It also allowed Markdown agents to be written and asked the mode question once.

zh.headline: 73 次本人提交，另有 22 次自动提交，覆盖五个仓库
zh.summary: 当天在五个仓库完成 **73 次本人提交**，另有 22 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 的 26 次提交加入中英双语命令行、按需下载的多语言字形变体、韩语 Galmuri 字体修复、布局调整，以及含 40 张示例图的文档扩充。`v0.2.0` 发布首个带标签版本，可用同一几何结构生成 PNG 与 SVG 像素画，支持五种画布、十套调色板及中英日韩混排。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 17 次提交将 `plain-language` 技能收紧到 46 行和六条红线，在 `AGENTS.md` 记录分支与分章开发流程，并更新角色名册和路由规则。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 16 次提交新增 `starlight-docs` 技能骨架及 detect、scaffold、check、audit、emit-check 脚本，恢复手机端主题与语言控件，并细化外链失败分级。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 8 次提交统一日报与摘要中的 issue、PR 动作数表述，拒绝裸 issue 计数，并补充分支开发要求。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 的 6 次提交落实候选菜单、按来源链和失败即拦截的比较检查门禁，`v3.0.1` 也使 README 与实际校验保持一致。

releaseNotes.summary: 首个带标签版本引入双语命令行，可将标题、副标题和脚注渲染为 8-bit 像素画。PNG 与 SVG 共用同一几何结构，提供五种画布、十套调色板，并支持中英日韩混排。
该版本落实候选菜单、按来源链和比较检查门禁，模型 ID 不再能被随意编造，`check` 会重新推导数值而非信任文件。同时允许编写 Markdown agents，并将模式问题合并为一次询问。
